note: No Referrer adds rel=noreferrer/noopener and referrerpolicy=no-referrer to external links and resources. Config object noreferrer.settings has booleans noreferrer/noopener/referrerpolicy (default TRUE), publish (FALSE), nullable subscribe_url, and allowed_domains (sequence, default []). Code-generated links are handled by hook_link_alter; user-generated content only if the 'noreferrer' text-format filter is enabled on a format (filter.format.<id>:filters.noreferrer.status). Settings at /admin/config/content/noreferrer (permission 'administer site configuration'; no module-specific permission). Allowlist matching is by Allowlist\Validator::isAllowed (exact host or subdomain). Medium cases read back a known allowed_domains list and a text format with the filter enabled; hard cases add a domain to allowed_domains and enable the noreferrer filter on a text format, verified against live config.

evals.prompt: On a Drupal site with the noreferrer module enabled, which configuration object and keys control whether rel="noreferrer", rel="noopener" and referrerpolicy="no-referrer" are added, and what are their default values?
evals.expected_output: Config object noreferrer.settings with boolean keys noreferrer, noopener and referrerpolicy, all defaulting to TRUE (plus publish=false, subscribe_url=null, allowed_domains=[]). Edit at /admin/config/content/noreferrer.

evals.prompt: I enabled the noreferrer module but the rel attributes are not being added to links inside my nodes' body/rich-text content. What do I have to do so the attributes are applied to user-generated content?
evals.expected_output: Code-generated links (menus, link fields) are handled automatically via hook_link_alter, but user-generated content is only processed if you enable the module's text-format filter (plugin id 'noreferrer', title 'Add referrerpolicy=..., rel=noopener and/or rel=noreferrer') on the relevant text format. It also fixes faulty/chopped HTML.

evals.prompt: How does the noreferrer module let me exempt certain trusted external domains from getting rel="noreferrer"/referrerpolicy, where is that list stored, and which service checks it?
evals.expected_output: Add hosts to noreferrer.settings:allowed_domains (space-separated in the settings form). The Allowlist\Validator::isAllowed($url) service checks whether a URL's host matches an allowed domain (exact host or any subdomain); matched links are skipped.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, which external domains are currently exempt from the noreferrer/referrerpolicy attributes? Inspect the live noreferrer configuration and list them.
evals.expected_output: noreferrer.settings:allowed_domains is [example.com, trusted-partner.org], so those two domains (and their subdomains) are exempt.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, exactly one text format has the No Referrer filter enabled, so its links get the rel/referrerpolicy attributes. Inspect the live filter format configuration and give the machine name of that text format.
evals.expected_output: The text format nrf_known has the noreferrer filter enabled (filter.format.nrf_known -> filters.noreferrer.status: true).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site we have a trusted analytics partner at trusted-partner.example and we do NOT want No Referrer to strip the referrer on links to it. Configure the noreferrer module so that trusted-partner.example is exempt (allowlisted), and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Add trusted-partner.example to noreferrer.settings:allowed_domains (via the settings form's space-separated 'Allowed domains' field, or set the config sequence directly). The verify checks the live allowed_domains list contains trusted-partner.example.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a text format with machine name nrf_task. Using the noreferrer module, make it so links and external resources in content using that format receive the No Referrer attributes, and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Enable the 'noreferrer' filter on the nrf_task text format (Text formats and editors UI, or set filter.format.nrf_task -> filters.noreferrer.status: true). The verify checks the noreferrer filter is enabled on nrf_task.
